item.tib: phywa tshe g.yang gi sgrub pa las g.yang 'gug nor bu'i phreng ba
item.coloph: phyis su dus la bab tshe las ldan gyi skyes bu/ stang chen dmu tsha'i bka' yi pho nya/ sprul pa'i sku mchog blo ldan snying po'i rjes 'bring / tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am/ g.yung drung thog (thogs) med rtsal du 'bod pa bdag la/ bka' gter chig dril du ngo mtshar gyi ltas dang bcas nas dngos grub du bab pa'o/ de la las ldan snying bu shes rab phun tshogs nas sngon gyi lha skal yin pa'i bag chags shar nas/ rin chen dang po mar zhi'i rten 'brel brda' mtshon te yang yang bskal ba la brten nas/ dkar chag yi ge shar grol smin gling du phab ste/ lo zla'i bka' rgya yol nas/ dben gnas dga' ri khrod du shog dril las bshus pa'o//
